chunks: And a group informed us, from Abu Muhammad Harun ibn Musa al-Talaqbari, from Abu Ali Muhammad ibn Himam, from Ja'far ibn Malik al-Kufi, from Muhammad ibn Ja'far ibn Abdullah, from Abu Nu'aym Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Ansari, and he narrated the hadith in its entirety.
ai.seo_question: Who are the narrators in the chain for the report of those who saw the Imam of the Time in Tusi's Kitab al-Ghayba?
ai.summary: This passage establishes the isnad (chain of transmission) for a lengthy tradition within Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, specifically focusing on the phenomenon of individuals witnessing the Imam of the Time (al-Mahdi) during his Minor and Major Gheibah. By tracing the lineage back to Abu Nu'aym al-Ansari, the text underscores the scholarly rigor and continuity of the 'Sahaba' and early Imami scholars who served as direct witnesses to the Hidden Imam, thereby validating the authenticity of the Ghayba narrative in Shia tradition.
